name: US equity stress
summary: VIX back below 20 and S&P 500 1.4% off its high after Democrats win Congress
state: The VIX was near 17.1 on 4 Nov, back below the 20 Watch line, and the S&P 500 was about 1.4% below its 52-week high (Yahoo Finance). Democrats won control of both the House and Senate in the 3 Nov midterms, removing an event risk markets had hedged (Time). The Bank of England (5 Nov) and US payrolls (6 Nov) are the next scheduled tests.
for_you: Equity markets are calm by this measure. Pension and investment values that track US shares are near recent highs; conditions can change quickly around central bank decisions and data releases.
rubric_hit: VIX 16.6 below the 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 1.67% below the 5% Watch line

sources.title: Time — Democrats win control of House and Senate

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
